about_the_game:
In a once-peaceful world, people were deceived by the illusion of fake love - a false controlling force that promised unity but delivered chains. That corrupted power twisted them into living turrets, trapped in metal shells, stripped of their hearts and freedom.

Turned into Turrets is  a story-driven roguelike survival game where you fight as those lost souls - humans bound by steel - battling endless hordes of monsters born from the same false love that doomed them. Your mission is to find the Seven Keys of True Love and unlock the emotions that can restore your humanity. Each boss defeated leads closer to freedom. 

ABOUT THE GAME

Turned Into Turrets is a top-down roguelike survival game where you stand as a living turret fighting through relentless waves of enemies. Every 15-level segment introduces new enemy types, culminating in a boss fight. Defeating each boss unlocks a new playable character, each with distinct stats such as increased speed and health.

Collect coins to fill your Upgrade Bar . When full, a set of Natural Powers appears. They are temporary ability choices that vanish after 10 seconds if ignored. Each refill slows slightly, testing your timing and decision-making. Traps scattered across the map can summon the Snake Woman (Fake Love) if triggered, or if you exceed the 5-minute limit without clearing the level.

Survive, upgrade, and master your abilities to overcome the waves and uncover the truth behind fake love.

CORE FEATURES

• Wave-based progression: enemy types change every 15 levels

• Boss fights that unlock new characters with unique speed or health stats

• Coin-driven upgrade system with timed Natural Power choices

• Gradually slower upgrade refill speed for deeper pacing

• Environmental traps that summon the Snake Woman if triggered or delayed

• Narrative integration through the Seven Keys of Love

THIS EARLY ACCESS INCLUDES

• 60 playable levels (4 enemy sets and 4 boss fights)

• 4 unlockable characters with different speed and health stats

• Full Upgrade-Bar and Natural Powers system

• One playable world (no map purchasing in early access)

• Early-access difficulty balancing for player feedback

LANGUAGES

• English

short_description: Once human, now machines forged by fake love. You just have five minutes to take down the waves of monsters and discover the path back to humanity. Turned Into Turrets is a 2D top-down roguelike game where you stand as a living turret, fighting waves of enemies with automatic attacks and builds.
